correctness.rationale: For every prime dividing the base, unequal digit valuations make divisibility automatic; equal digit valuations make the lower-position valuation exact, yielding the sharp exponent threshold. Coprime remainder of digit sum transforms into an exact multiplicative-order gap test. Independent summation yields the exact all-length finite floor formula; quadratic expansion and 48-residue certificate prove the asymptotic coefficients and minimal cycle. The standalone script independently checks integer divisibility, all decimal pair classes and rational coefficients.

value.rationale: Support-two digital sums are the first natural nontrivial Hamming-weight stratum of Niven numbers, distinct from unrestricted fixed-digit-sum counting. The all-base exact formula captures finite-length behavior and its prime-adic and multiplicative-order structure; the unexpected decimal proportion 1483/1944 and sharp 48-phase bounded oscillation are informative exact arithmetic invariants. This is more than a routine rename or finite table recalculation.
